level.title: Proficient Urdu
goals: Communicate connected ideas accurately for the level.
Adapt register and structure to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Urdu with script, romanisation, and cultural awareness.

lessons.title: Nuanced public-health communication
lessons.learn: Control formal register, cohesion, and stance. Distinguish a factual claim from interpretation and adapt wording for professional, academic, and public audiences. This lesson applies that control to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Nuanced public-health communication — discourse control
grammar.explain: Control formal register, cohesion, and stance. Distinguish a factual claim from interpretation and adapt wording for professional, academic, and public audiences.
grammar.pattern: context + main point + support/qualification + audience-appropriate close
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically; preserve natural Urdu verb-final structure and match respect, gender, and number to the context.

practice.q: Translate precisely: گال (gaal)
